name: Will a cash offer for a luxury home mean skipping the appraisal and inspection?

mainEntity.name: Will a cash offer for a luxury home mean skipping the appraisal and inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. While a cash offer eliminates the need for an appraisal required by a lender, a cash buyer may still opt for an appraisal to ensure they are paying a fair market value for the luxury property. Similarly, a buyer can still choose to conduct a home inspection to assess the property's condition, even with a cash offer. These are common contingencies buyers include to protect their investment, providing preparation steps for the seller to consider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cash offers do not automatically skip appraisals or inspections; buyers may still conduct them to protect their investment and verify value.
